sources.citation: S. Worley, A Cellular Texture Basis Function, SIGGRAPH 1996 (feature points per cell, the distances F1 and F2, and F2 - F1 for cell borders)
K. Perlin, Improving Noise, SIGGRAPH 2002, ACM TOG 21(3) (the interpolant 6t^5 - 15t^4 + 10t^3 and the cube-edge gradients, here on the z = 0 plane)

D. S. Ebert, F. K. Musgrave et al., Texturing and Modeling: A Procedural Approach, 3rd ed., 2003 (F. K. Musgrave's fBm with lacunarity 2 and the ridged multifractal; D. Peachey's periodic patterns from the integer and fractional parts of a coordinate)
A. Lagae et al., A Survey of Procedural Noise Functions, Computer Graphics Forum 29(8), 2010 (periodic lattice noise: the lattice index taken modulo the period, so the texture tiles)
M. Jarzynski, M. Olano, Hash Functions for GPU Rendering, Journal of Computer Graphics Techniques 9(3), 2020 (pcg3d: the lattice hash of every cell)
J. F. Blinn, Simulation of Wrinkled Surfaces, SIGGRAPH 1978 (the normal perturbed by the height field's partial derivatives, here central differences)

T. Luft, C. Colditz, O. Deussen, Image Enhancement by Unsharp Masking the Depth Buffer, ACM TOG 25(3), SIGGRAPH 2006 (the local mean of the height minus the height as the crevice term of the occlusion output)

C. Lomont, Fast Inverse Square Root, technical report, Purdue University, 2003 (the initial estimate 0x5F375A86 - (bits >> 1) refined by Newton steps; it normalises the normal output without a division)
